evidence.title: GitHub - cathrynlavery/diagram-design: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, and Pi. 44 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG.

name: Diagram Design
summary: Agent skill that draws editorial diagrams as self-contained HTML + SVG in your brand; 44 diagram types, no build step.
description: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Pi and other Agent Skills-compatible hosts: it picks a diagram type (flowchart, architecture, Sankey, Wardley map, kanban, UML class, database schema …), builds one self-contained HTML + SVG file with no build step, and matches your brand by reading your website (colors, fonts, WCAG AA contrast checks). Imports from draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw; exports PNG/SVG.
contains: 44 diagram types (repo listing; README 2.5.10 lists 39), incl. Sankey, Wardley map, UML class, kanban
each type ships in three static variants: minimal light, minimal dark, full-editorial
output is one self-contained HTML + SVG file — no build step, no JavaScript, no external images
brand onboarding extracts paper/ink/accent colors and fonts from your site, with WCAG AA contrast checks
named brand profiles for multiple clients (~/.diagram-design/profiles)
imports draw.io, Mermaid and Excalidraw; exports PNG and SVG
installs as a plugin/skill for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Pi, Kiro and OpenCode
